forum.best_answer_content:
HI @LH1

you could probably find some answers in following documents:

* [AN5587 Integration of STM32MP13x MPU product lines and STPMIC1D / STPMIC1A on a wall adapter supply](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5587-integration-of-stm32mp13x-mpu-product-lines-and-stpmic1d--stpmic1a-on-a-wall-adapter-supply-stmicroelectronics.pdf)

+ especially figure 2

* [AN6312 How to use STPMIC1L for a wall adapter powered application on STM32MP13x lines MPUs](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an6312-how-to-use-stpmic1l-for-a-wall-adapter-powered-application-on--stm32mp13x-lines-mpus--stmicroelectronics.pdf)

* [AN5586 STM32MP13x MPU product line discrete power supply hardware integration](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5586-stm32mp13x-mpu-product-line-discrete-power-supply-hardware-integration-stmicroelectronics.pdf)

Regards.
